sql:
SELECT
    s.StoreKey,
    s.StoreName,
    sum(fos.SalesAmount) AS total_sales,
    sum(fos.SalesAmount) / nullIf(countDistinct(fos.SalesOrderNumber), 0) AS average_order_value,
    countDistinct(fos.SalesOrderNumber) AS number_of_transactions
FROM retail.FactOnlineSales AS fos
INNER JOIN retail.DimStore AS s
    ON fos.StoreKey = s.StoreKey
GROUP BY
    s.StoreKey,
    s.StoreName
ORDER BY total_sales DESC
